subject: Sandbox provisioning request & slot bump for Hosted API evaluation
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cartwheel.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@cartwheel.ai>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox access and demo — Cartwheel AI evaluation

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the quick onboarding flow — our engineering team signed up and started a short evaluation against the hosted API. We hit a blocker: we need a short-lived sandbox with a larger token allowance (batch testing) and access to model variants you mentioned in the docs. Is it possible to get a sandbox account with:
- 1M token cap for a 72-hour window
- embeddings+generation enabled
- a logging endpoint or temporary access to debug logs (read-only)

Also, a couple of us (Priya and I) would like a live walkthrough to validate latency and token accounting. Our best windows are today 3–4pm PT or tomorrow morning. If you can provision the sandbox, we can confirm a slot immediately.

I've attached a short requirements file (requirements.xlsx) with our test scenarios.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of ML Systems
Cartwheel AI

Attachment: requirements.xlsx (Excel, 42 KB)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cartwheel.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@cartwheel.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox access and demo — Cartwheel AI evaluation

Alex — thanks for the details and the sheet, that helps. Happy to get you a short-lived sandbox with the increases you requested. I'll loop Diego (SDR ops) to provision the sandbox and book a 30-min evaluation. Mina on infra will confirm logging access policy.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Today 15:30–16:00
- Tomorrow 09:00–09:30

If you need an earlier time today, let Diego know and we can try to bump the session. For the sandbox, Diego will need the team e-mail list that should have access (send names/emails) and whether you want token limits applied by project or per-email.

Action items:
- Alex/Priya: confirm preferred slot + list of sandbox users
- Diego: provision sandbox (1M tokens, 72h) and send access stub
- Mina: confirm whether debug logs can be exposed to a temporary storage bucket (read-only)

I'll stay on the thread to make sure we don't miss anything.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cartwheel.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@cartwheel.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox access and demo — Cartwheel AI evaluation

Thanks Aditya — I'm on it. Alex/Priya, I created a temporary sandbox project and queued the token uplift. Details below:
- Sandbox project: cartwheel-eval-20260807
- Token cap: 1,000,000 tokens for 72 hours (starts when you first call the endpoint)
- Models: gpt-redwood-medium, gpt-redwood-quant (both enabled)
- Access method: invite by email (send list)

I've attached the access stub with example API keys and a short preflight checklist. Please send the list of accounts you want added and confirm which slot you'd like.

Available calendar slots (PT):
- Today 15:30–16:00 (we can still make this if you confirm within 30 minutes)
- Tomorrow 09:00–09:30
- Tomorrow 11:00–11:30 (alternate)

Preflight checklist (short):
1) Add emails to project invite
2) Confirm which model for the walk — we recommend starting on gpt-redwood-medium
3) Share a single test prompt that exercises long-sequence tokens

Attachment: sandbox-access.txt (text, 2 KB)
Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1bXk3-example

—Diego
Diego Fernandez
SDR, Redwood Inference

Diego — thanks for the fast turnaround. We can confirm the sandbox users:
- alex.turner@cartwheel.ai
- priya@cartwheel.ai
- james.li@cartwheel.ai

We originally asked for 3:30pm today but an exec call came up. Can you bump the session to 14:30–15:00 PT instead? It's urgent for us to get the walkthrough before an internal architecture review. If 14:30 doesn't work, please keep 15:30 as our fallback.

Also, can you confirm that debug logs will be routed to a read-only GCS bucket? If Mina can confirm that's safe, we can proceed.

—Alex
Sent from my iPhone
